result.summary: The accepted findings establish a rent-increase dispute and that the reported reason is renovation work. Whether Hannah received a formal rent-increase notice remains unknown, so the notice date and any challenge-deadline position cannot be established. The evaluated checklist lists as missing the required lease contract, rent-increase notice, proof of receipt, current-rent evidence, prior-rent adjustment, stated reasons and calculation, and renovation-cost breakdown. It also lists landlord correspondence as optional and address-change notice/landlord address records as suggested.
result.answer: The file does not establish whether a formal rent-increase notice was sent or received, or whether the increase is too high. First establish notice and receipt details promptly, then review the notice and calculation evidence; the current information is insufficient to assess a challenge.
open_points: Was a formal rent-increase notice sent or received, and when and at what address was it delivered? The notice and proof of receipt are listed as missing.
The lease contract, current-rent evidence, prior-rent adjustment, stated reasons and calculation, and renovation-cost breakdown are listed as missing.

Landlord correspondence is listed as missing but optional; address-change notice and landlord address records are listed as missing but suggested, and could also help clarify where any notice was sent.
The manager's reported oral explanation attributes the increase to renovation work, but the renovation cost allocation and calculation are not documented.

clauses.text: We understand that you are asking about a rent increase which you were told is due to renovation work.

Please let us know whether you have since found or received a formal rent-increase notice, and, if so, when and at what address it was delivered; please send us the notice and any delivery or receipt evidence.
Please also provide your lease contract, evidence of your current rent and any previous rent adjustment, and the landlord's stated reasons and calculation for the increase.
As the increase was reportedly attributed to renovation work, please send any renovation cost breakdown showing the works, costs and amount allocated to rent.
If available, please also send any correspondence with the landlord, and any address-change notice or landlord records showing which address was used for notification.

learning.title: Clarify notification and delivery address when receipt is uncertain
learning.why: In a rent-increase dispute where the claimant is unsure whether a notice was received, the question should establish not only whether it was received but also the address used and the timing, to help identify notice/receipt evidence and preserve the deadline assessment.
learning.question: Have you received or found a formal rent-increase notice? If not, do you know whether one was sent, which address the landlord used, and whether you notified the landlord of an address change? Please provide any notice, delivery evidence, or address-change records.
learning.applies_when_text: For rent-increase disputes when the claimant's receipt of a formal notice is uncertain.
learning.reason: This case explicitly leaves receipt uncertain and describes uncertainty about whether the landlord updated the claimant's address, so the existing receipt-status question alone does not elicit all relevant notification details.
